thread:
alina: morning team — noticed a subtle uptick in unassigned leads after the enrichment tweak last night. SLA p90 nudged up. anyone on routing now? :coffee:
marco: I saw it. traces show enrich responses arriving shortly after assignment windows close; leads fall back to unassigned. seems like a timing/race issue rather than mapping errors.
riley: we tightened enrich deadline to 18s to speed throughput. good for latency most times but brittle on spikes.
hubspot-bot: alert: inbound.handoff.unassigned_rate=5.1% window=12m source=hubspot-sync service=lead-router
zara: idea: implement "owner-shadow" — router picks an owner locally and holds a private shadow assignment for up to 90s waiting for enrich. only write owner to HubSpot/Salesforce after enrich completes or after a longer fallback window. meanwhile, route to an "amber" overflow with holdback so SDRs don't sequence immediately.
alina: owner-shadow reduces customer-visible unassigneds while avoiding bad owner writes. sounds promising. what telemetry do we need?
marco: emit inbound.handoff.shadow_count, shadow_hit_rate, and shadow_write_latency. tweak handoff-heartbeat to show shadow_vs_direct ratio per minute. add a tag shadow.experiment=amber for canary leads.
riley: implementation notes: new transient state SHADOW_WAIT (ttl=90s). transitions: RECEIVE -> SHADOW_WAIT -> ASSIGNED (if enrich ok) OR AMBER_FALLBACK (if not). set lead.meta.owner_shadow_id and lead.meta.enrich_status. also set defer_write_to_crm=true.
zara: overflow rules: amber pool gets tag amber_hold=true and is excluded from outbound for 60m. after 60m if enrich still missing, we either write a placeholder owner or surface to SDRs with reason=awaiting_enrich.
alina: canary plan? small and observable.
marco: canary 6% for 45 minutes. rollback triggers: a) unassigned_rate increases >x1.4 b) shadow_write_latency_p95 > baseline*2 c) amber_hold_count > 3% of inbound. config snippet below for rollout.
riley: config snippet (will deploy as canary=6%):
```
router.handoff = {
  owner_shadow_enabled: true,
  shadow_ttl_seconds: 90,
  defer_write_to_crm: true,
  amber_pool: {
    hold_minutes: 60,
    exclude_from_sequences: true
  },
  canary_percent: 6
}
```
zara: HubSpot saved filter to inspect amber leads: `properties.pending_status = "amber_hold" AND created_at > -1h`. Also add a SF report for deferred_owner leads.
alina: owners: marco=code+canary rollout, riley=telemetry+heartbeat change, zara=HS/SF filters and SDR playbook update, me=CSM notify + SLA doc update. target start in 30m and a post-canary quick check at +45m.
hubspot-bot: deploy.scheduled: canary=6% scheduled_by=marco start=4807654560
marco: kicking off canary now. I'll post short deltas every 10m. please flag if you see user impact or unexpected owner churn.
zara: small UX ask: in SDR UI show an "Amber" badge with hover text "Awaiting enrichment / hold for X mins" so reps know why a lead is suppressed. I'll file a ticket.
riley: long-term follow-up: consider an adaptive shadow TTL driven by enrich latency trends and a circuit-breaker on enrichment upstream. also add replica lag alerts for the enrich DB.
alina: thanks team. quick wins first, then durability work. if anything spikes, @here and we'll rollback. :rocket:
